I am going to analyze this video, which shows a wingsuit skydive through clouds. I can clearly see the need to define the 60 intervals that will be generated, starting from 00:00:00.000 to 00:01:00.000. Each caption needs to represent a one-second chunk.

Then, comes the creative part. Each caption is a distillation of the visual information. It needs to give the sense of motion and the scenery. So I'm thinking about the point-of-view – is it the skydiver's perspective? Am I seeing another skydiver? The clouds are a huge element here, their density, their movement, how they reveal the land and the ocean below. I'm noting the camera movements, the pan across the horizon, the shifting focus.
